macros.name: mtt
macros.doc: \mtt redefines several ‘short’ commands to typeset the obvious characters.

macros.name: mttfamily
macros.doc: The command \mttfamily selects the properly-encoded Typewriter font.

macros.name: textmtt
macros.doc: a command \textmtt is provided: it just typesets its argument in the re-encoded Typewriter font.
